reason: Curator rated multiple otherwise excellent reproductions 4★ solely because ornamental external physical frames were visible; do not conflate frame trim with artistic or image fidelity quality.

artisticSuitability.meaning: Aesthetic and subject appropriateness of the physical work; does not change because frame included in source photograph.

photoFidelity.example: 5★ if otherwise excellent even when external physical frame surrounds painted surface; attach trim-needed flag.

choices.frame: External decorative frame included: trim in app review derivative only
choices.clean: No external frame: full painted surface already visible
choices.painted: Painted border/inscription physically part of original composition: retain
choices.straighten: Photo keystone/perspective alignment to correct on derivative
choices.source: Better original master actually required beyond normal frame removal

quality4LegacyPolicy.existingFourScoreCount: 35 judgments across 33 original IDs (source inventory, before new annotations)
quality4LegacyPolicy.reinterpretation: Do not bulk-upgrade rating. Mark frame as removable if visually confirmed; optionally re-rate photo 5 when fidelity otherwise excellent; keep full source master and provenance.
quality4LegacyPolicy.editorialOverride: No automatic inference that every historical 4★ meant frame-only

cropPipeline.method: Non-destructive derived copy with source-original SHA, normalized crop rectangle and derivative SHA
rules: Never cut painted surface, signatures, relevant inscription or painted border
Do not equate an overlay or PDF border with external physical frame without visual check
Respect original aspect ratio unless perspective correction indicated
Store coordinates only after manual/visual confirmation, not guessed automatic cropping
Keep original file, rights terms, photographer credit and source URL

deploymentGate: No production asset release or proposed 4★ upgrade until exact object identity, image master rights and visual crop QA pass.
